mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a beautiful day with clear skies at Harriet Park and a comfortable temperature of 77 degrees, though it feels like 80.

In city news, the I Voted sticker contest has concluded with four winners selected from over fifty student entries, and their designs will be available at polling locations this November. Additionally, the Verona police department continues to monitor local traffic safety and juvenile activities.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the Epic user group meeting taking place today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can check out trivia at the Hop Haus Brewing Company or the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking back at the police department report, an incident occurred on August 15 when a woman was arrested for her first O W I offence after being found passed out behind the wheel of her vehicle.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for our flavor of the day, Caramel Peanut Buttercup. The restaurant is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to get your fix.
